title: Computer / Hardware / Software
content_html:
Computer / Hardware / Software

Computer / Host
• OS: Windows 11 Home, x64
• CPU: AMD Ryzen 9 7900 (12-core)
• GPU: NVIDIA RTX 3060 12 GB
• RAM: 128 GB
• Backup: OneDrive (encrypted)

Open WebUI
• Install: pip install open-webui
• Run: open-webui serve
• Local URL: http://localhost:8080
• Runs directly on Windows (no Docker)

Cloudflare Tunnel (for Open WebUI)
• Tunnel name: Orion Access
• Backend/origin: http://127.0.0.1:8080
• Windows service: Cloudflared
• Installed with:
   cloudflared.exe service install <token>
• Check status:
   sc.exe query Cloudflared (look for STATE : 4 RUNNING)

SearXNG (via Docker)
• App: SearXNG (searxng-docker repo)
• Project root path (Windows):
   C:\Users\drtre\OneDrive\Desktop\Library\Orion Forge\Orion Forge\searxng\searxng-docker
• Docker prerequisites:
   – Docker Desktop installed on Windows
   – WSL2 backend enabled (recommended)
• Start SearXNG:
   – Open terminal in project root
   – Run: docker compose up -d
• Stop SearXNG:
   – From project root: docker compose down
• Check status:
   – docker ps (look for SearXNG containers)
• SearXNG URL (default):
   – http://127.0.0.1:3000/

Usage Workflow
• Start WebUI on the PC:
   open-webui serve
• Ensure Cloudflared service is running (once per boot):
   sc.exe query Cloudflared
• Remote access URL:
   https://run.orionforge.chat/
   http://localhost:8080 (adjust if you changed ports)

Ollama
• Server URL: http://localhost:11434
• Default chat: llama3.1:8b
• Build/code: qwen2.5-coder:32b
• Cloud big brain: kimi / glm
